title: Mac Explorer — Open-source Mac File Manager for macOS
description: Mac Explorer is an open-source Mac file manager with split panes, vertical tabs, tab groups, gallery and quick previews, PDF & OCR search, batch rename, Git actions, SFTP and LocalSend for Apple Silicon and Intel.
appStoreDownload: Get it on the App Store
eyebrow: MADE FOR macOS · FREE & OPEN SOURCE
faqTitle: A few things before you start
faqs: Mac Explorer is an open-source Mac file manager for macOS. It brings split panes, vertical tabs, workspace groups, instant previews, content search and transfers into one window.
Will it affect Apple’s built-in Finder?
No. Mac Explorer runs as an independent app and never modifies or replaces Finder. You can use both side by side and uninstall anytime without touching your files.
Requires macOS 14 or later, on Apple Silicon or Intel.
How do the website and App Store editions differ?

The website edition is free and open source, with plugins, scripts and terminal actions. The App Store edition uses a subscription and system folder authorization. See its store listing for features and pricing.
Are my files and search data uploaded?

File indexes, tags and image recognition results stay on your Mac. Optional location lookup, user-configured AI services and file transfers connect to the corresponding services or selected devices. See the privacy policy for details.
endText: Found a bug or have a feature in mind? Open an issue on GitHub. To build your own plugin, start with the SDK.

intro: A file manager made for macOS. Browse, find, organize and share, all in one window.
browserAlt: Mac Explorer file list and context menus: stacked windows with built-in background themes, project browsing, editing, moving, sharing and file conversion, including toolbar tags and the right-hand information panel

capabilities.label: 01 / BROWSE & ORGANIZE
capabilities.title: Multiple folders. One window.
capabilities.intro: Bring files, folders and projects into a view that works for you.
items: Split panes, vertical tabs and groups
Work side by side in two to four panes, or switch to a hover-expanding vertical tab bar. Save tab groups as presets to restore entire layouts in one click.
Switch between list, icon, tree and gallery views. Resize thumbnails with the slider, jump by typing initials, and narrow down with grouping and column filters.
See drives, workspace groups, frequent folders and recent files on the Workbench. Organize with nested tags and star ratings without moving originals.
Check sizes, camera metadata and SHA-256 checksums at a glance. Open Disk Management from the sidebar to inspect mounted volumes and eject safely.

capabilities.label: 02 / SEARCH & PREVIEW
capabilities.title: A small clue. The right file.
capabilities.intro: Find what matters and see what’s inside without switching windows.
items: Press ⌘ K to find filenames, PDF text and image OCR. Preview the selected match right in the panel or jump straight to its folder.
Browse photos by people, recognized text, scenes, dates and locations. Name groups of people, with all recognition running locally on your Mac.
Quick previews, video and code diffs
Press Space for images, PDFs, Office docs, archives and native video playback. Edit Markdown live and compare side-by-side code diffs.
Combine replacements, numbering, dates, templates and regex rules. Preview every new name, catch conflicts, save presets and undo a completed batch.

capabilities.label: 03 / PROCESS & TRANSFER
capabilities.title: Keep your file work together.
capabilities.intro: From local operations to remote folders, stay in your flow.
items: Double-click archives to browse inside and extract single items, or create encrypted ZIPs. Convert docs to Word or PDF and batch-resize images.
Run copies, transfers and extractions in the background with pause, resume and retry. Compare conflicting files side by side before replacing or keeping both.
SFTP, SMB, WebDAV and network discovery
Manage SFTP files with automatic upload on save. Mount SMB and WebDAV via macOS and discover local network servers automatically.
Send files and folders from the context menu and confirm devices before receiving, or share selected items directly via AirDrop.

capabilities.label: 04 / YOUR WORKFLOW
capabilities.title: Make it work your way.
capabilities.intro: Keep everyday actions close, and make repetitive work easier.
items: Menu bar delivery and file staging
Reach Downloads, Desktop and favorites from the menu bar. Drop scattered files into staging to preview and drag copies into other apps without moving originals.
Use natural language to find files, organize selections, prepare renames or convert formats. Review and confirm every plan before changes happen.
View Git diffs, commit history and stage changes from the context menu. The website edition also supports plugins and custom shell commands.
Pick built-in background themes, light or dark glass, and custom folder covers. Resize and group the sidebar, tailor shortcuts, and hold ⌘ for hints.
